models.name: Constraints of fbc Version 3
models.notes:
Example of what the third version of the fbc package adds to a constraint based model.

A user defined constraint bounds a linear combination of fluxes which the stoichiometry of the network does not couple: ratio holds the flux of v2 at twice the flux of v1, and budget weighs a reaction against a parameter which a simulation may change.

A flux objective says whether it enters the objective function linearly or quadratically, and a quadratic one may name a second reaction, so that the product of two fluxes is optimised. The charge of a species is a double here and not an integer, because a pseudoisomer carries the average charge of the species it stands for.

Key value pairs are the controlled annotation of the package: a key, its value and the address at which the key is defined, written on any element which needs metadata that no other attribute of SBML holds.

listOfReactions.name: uptake
listOfReactions.xml:
<reaction id="v1" name="uptake" reversible="false" fast="false" compartment="cell" fbc:lowerFluxBound="zero" fbc:upperFluxBound="ub">
  <listOfReactants>
    <speciesReference species="glc" stoichiometry="1" constant="true"/>
  </listOfReactants>
  <listOfProducts>
    <speciesReference species="pi" stoichiometry="1" constant="true"/>
  </listOfProducts>
  <fbc:geneProductAssociation fbc:id="gpa_v1" fbc:name="association of the uptake">
    <fbc:or>
      <fbc:and>
        <fbc:geneProductRef fbc:geneProduct="g_ptsG"/>
        <fbc:geneProductRef fbc:geneProduct="g_ptsH"/>
      </fbc:and>
      <fbc:geneProductRef fbc:id="ref_galP" fbc:geneProduct="g_galP"/>
    </fbc:or>
  </fbc:geneProductAssociation>
</reaction>

geneProductAssociation.name: association of the uptake

<fbc:geneProductAssociation fbc:id="gpa_v1" fbc:name="association of the uptake">

</fbc:geneProductAssociation>

listOfObjectives.name: maximal growth
listOfObjectives.xml:
<fbc:objective fbc:id="growth_max" fbc:name="maximal growth" fbc:type="maximize">
  <fbc:listOfFluxObjectives>
    <fbc:fluxObjective fbc:id="fo_biomass" fbc:name="the biomass term" fbc:reaction="EX_biomass" fbc:coefficient="1" fbc:variableType="linear"/>
  </fbc:listOfFluxObjectives>
</fbc:objective>

listOfFluxObjectives.xml: <fbc:fluxObjective fbc:id="fo_biomass" fbc:name="the biomass term" fbc:reaction="EX_biomass" fbc:coefficient="1" fbc:variableType="linear"/>

listOfUserDefinedConstraints.name: the growth is twice the uptake
listOfUserDefinedConstraints.notes: 2 v1 - v2 = 0, a constraint the stoichiometry of the network does not impose.
listOfUserDefinedConstraints.xml: 2 v1 - v2 = 0, a constraint the stoichiometry of the network does not impose.

listOfUserDefinedConstraintComponents.name: twice the uptake
listOfUserDefinedConstraintComponents.xml: <fbc:userDefinedConstraintComponent fbc:id="ratio_v1" fbc:name="twice the uptake" fbc:coefficient="c_two" fbc:variable="v1" fbc:variableType="linear"/>

listOfUserDefinedConstraints.name: the maintenance demand of the growth
listOfUserDefinedConstraints.xml:
<fbc:userDefinedConstraint fbc:id="budget" fbc:name="the maintenance demand of the growth" fbc:lowerBound="ratio_lb" fbc:upperBound="budget_ub">
  <fbc:listOfUserDefinedConstraintComponents>
    <fbc:userDefinedConstraintComponent fbc:id="budget_v2" fbc:coefficient="c_one" fbc:variable="v2" fbc:variable2="maintenance" fbc:variableType="quadratic"/>
  </fbc:listOfUserDefinedConstraintComponents>
</fbc:userDefinedConstraint>
